dialogs.about: 은행에 가기 전에 딸과 통장과 비밀번호를 이야기해요

lines.en: Good morning. Can you help me today?
lines.ko: 좋은 아침이에요. 오늘 저 좀 도와줄래요?

lines.en: Of course, Mom. What do you need?
I want to open a savings account.
That's nice. The teller will help you.
I forgot my PIN last week.
Don't worry. You can choose a new PIN.
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요. 새 비밀번호를 고를 수 있어요.

lines.en: Can I use the ATM on my own?
lines.ko: 제가 혼자 현금 인출기를 쓸 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, and I will stand beside you.
Thank you. I will deposit my money there.
You are welcome. Let's go after lunch.

dialogs.about: 은행 창구에서 직원에게 출금과 송금을 물어보고 도움을 받아요

lines.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
I want to withdraw some money, please.
Sure. May I see your bank book?
Here it is. I found it this morning.
Thank you. Please put in your PIN.
I put it in. Is the interest high now?
Our savings interest is a little higher.
Good. Can I remit money to my son?
Yes. I will send it for you now.
Thank you so much for your help today.
